name: continuous-improvement
description: Ambition and discipline for coding agents, beginner mode of the MCP server: 4 tools for status, the saved lessons, a reflection template and a file-gate clearance. The bundled skills, be-ambitious among them, are guidance the agent reads. Only a hook refuses a call.

tools.name: ci_status
tools.what: See what the system has learned about your project

tools.name: ci_instincts
tools.what: List all learned behaviors with confidence levels

tools.name: ci_reflect
tools.what: Reflect on what you did this session

tools.name: ci_gateguard_clear
tools.what: Clear the GateGuard gate for files after presenting facts

hooks.description: Where the hooks are installed (the Claude Code plugin, or install --target <agent> --hooks; per agent in docs/AGENT-SUPPORT.md): hooks/gateguard.mjs denies destructive commands and blind edits before they run, and bin/observe.mjs logs each tool call that runs. The prompt hooks stay off until you set CI_ROUTE_PROMPT=1 or CI_RECALL_BRIEFING=1.
